chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Indeed, among the Sunnah is that the Imam does not depart from Mina to Arafah until the sun rises."
And there is no harm if the pedestrian and the one with an excuse depart from Mina before praying, and he prays on the way. Narrated.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ اَلْعُذْرِ: The one with an excuse (e.g., illness, age)

ai.seo_question: When should the Imam depart from Mina to Arafah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* delineates the hierarchical protocol for the Hajj ritual of Wuquf at Arafah, distinguishing the Imam’s Sunnah of delaying departure until sunrise from the permissibility for ordinary pilgrims to leave earlier and pray en route. It reflects the scholarly understanding of flexibility within the Sunnah, allowing for practical accommodation of the masses while maintaining the ceremonial precedence of the Imam. This distinction underscores the balance between ritual precision and communal ease in Shia jurisprudence.
